label_set.provenance: Adam Jackson, 2026-11-18, bulk chat confirmation "go with the latest decisions"; six unchanged main-pass questions and two Proposed v2 columns.

assumptions: Minimum precision 0.8 and recall 0.8 are assumed, not achieved or owner-confirmed.
All rows are dev; historical pairs share leakage groups, no held-out evaluation.
Review recommendations are deferred, not silently applied.
Raw probabilities are not calibrated confidence.
Eval host selects model; runtime judge() does not expose model pinning or metadata. The batch-reported scoring model is preserved here.

results.scoring: Each labelled judge-asked case scored once on its own question for the final frozen extractor/state version. A superseded preliminary extractor version was scored before final extraction changed; those probabilities were discarded, never mixed or used to tune.
